---
title: "Kentucky Stroke Map Demo"
subtitle: "Fake county-level stroke rates"
---

This is a minimal Quarto document for testing Posit Connect Cloud deployment. The map below uses Kentucky county boundaries stored in this repository and joins them to a small fake stroke dataset generated at render time.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

counties <- st_read("data/kentucky_counties.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326)

set.seed(20260506)

stroke_data <- counties |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(
    GEOID,
    county = NAME,
    stroke_rate = round(runif(n(), min = 2.8, max = 7.6), 1),
    stroke_cases = sample(40:240, size = n(), replace = TRUE)
  )

map_data <- counties |>
  left_join(stroke_data, by = "GEOID")

ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = stroke_rate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#d8eef7",
    high = "#c2410c",
    name = "Stroke rate (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fake Stroke Rates Across Kentucky Counties",
    subtitle = "Synthetic data for deployment testing only",
    caption = "County boundaries: bundled GeoJSON derived from U.S. Census cartographic boundary shapefiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
stroke_data |>
  arrange(desc(stroke_rate)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

The table above shows the counties with the highest fake stroke rates in this demo.
